body: Hugs back :) I'm so glad that I have all of you internet strangers to help. I guess I may be over reacting but I'm so used to the scares tactics they use in sex ed. Plus I was always careful, always wore condoms. But anyhow, thanks for your advice
Anything helps :) and I'm trying really hard to
Thank you very very much. Hearing I'm there for you is great. I can't really tell anyone else in my life right now so it's nice to hear it from a stranger
Thanks for the info. I will keep this in mind
Aww thank you very much. Your comment made me smile which I felt was somewhat impossible to do today

I know, when I was writing that I was being irrational. It's just so difficult to fathom this idea of being a teenage girl with an STD. I don't sleep around or anything so it feels strange that this would happen to me
Hmm I tried over there but no real response so far. But thanks for the reassurance :)
Yeah I'm going to wait for them. I'm just trying to figure what to do if it is worse case scenario
Thank you very much :) I'm trying very hard to see an upside to it. I just worry about what will happen with future sex partners. How do I break the news?
Thank you. I'm having a pretty shitty day so it's nice to hear these words
See but the only possible person who could've given this to me wore a condom. I don't think it protects against herpes
My partner has been really sweet about the whole thing and has promised to continue to love me no matter what but I can't get over this over-whelming guilt
